Where should Legato keep its copies of a plan's image files?

questions.question: Where should Legato keep its copies of a plan's image files?

options.label: Beside the plan (Recommended)
options.description: In the plan's own folder, so the files move and are removed with it.

options.label: In a shared cache
options.description: One folder for every plan, each file kept once by its content hash.

options.label: Leave them where they are
options.description: Link to the original path; a moved or deleted file breaks the plan.

approvals.title: How often should the glasses read Legato while the screen is on?

questions.question: How often should the glasses read Legato while the screen is on?

options.label: Every 5 seconds (Recommended)
options.description: Uses a little more battery on the phone.

options.label: Every 15 seconds
options.description: Gentler on the battery; a new question can wait up to 15 s.

questions.question: What should background mode show across the top?

options.label: Who needs you
options.description: The first agent waiting on you, by task.

options.label: Agent counts
options.description: Running, waiting and idle, dim on the right.

options.label: Glasses battery
options.description: Its level, and a mark while charging.
